dataset: NASA GISS GISTEMP v4 Land-Ocean Temperature Index (GHCNv4/ERSSTv5, 1200 km)
grid: 2 degree by 2 degree; 90 latitude x 180 longitude
map_projection: equirectangular; cell centers at NASA coordinates
rendering: Each source cell displayed at its true 2-degree footprint. Missing cells transparent. Nearest-neighbor display; no spatial interpolation. Color limits ±5 K with endpoint clipping.
musical_mapping: 24 west-to-east 15-degree longitude sectors, 3 latitude bands; cos(latitude)-weighted mean over finite cells. MIDI=clip(round(66+3.6*mean_K),48,84); velocity=clip(round(48+8*abs(mean_K)),48,112). Each sector starts at its integer second; each note lasts 0.75 s. Timbre is artistic.
scientific_scope: Monthly temperature anomalies relative to 1951-1980, not absolute temperature, daily observations, or recorded environmental sound. Notes represent regional summaries, not individual grid cells.
note_audit_location: Each YYYY-MM.json includes note_events with numeric source summaries and MIDI assignments.
